description: Every metric the ledger measures or archives: key, unit, definition id, whether it is a headline figure, its first stored sample, and the date from which its history compares across our own changes (comparable_since). Use a filter (part of a key, a definition id or a word from its note) to get the notes too.

filter.description: Optional: part of a key, a definition id or a word, e.g. l8, bridge, x402

title: List the measured metrics
